Hero.title: Your Professional Website & Online Agenda
Hero.subtitleLine1: You set your hours. Patients book online. You approve with one click.

Features.title: Your practice shouldn't feel like a call center
Features.intro: Every phone call you answer during patient care is a lost moment of focus. Every voicemail you return is a chore. Every "calendar dance" is a waste of time.
Features.painAdminDebtBody: Your staff spends hours repeating availability, spelling names, and checking slots.
Features.painSilentLeaksBody: Patients call after hours, get no answer, and book with the clinic down the street.
Features.closing: DocCy was built to stop this cycle.

AdoptionPlaybook.title: Shift phone traffic to the screen
AdoptionPlaybook.lead: Your patients don't want to wait on hold, and your staff shouldn't spend four hours a day repeating available slots.

weekendShield.title: The Weekend Shield
weekendShield.body: Clinics in Cyprus close evenings, weekends, and lunch breaks. We give you a voicemail script that sends callers to your DocCy link, so Saturday callers book instead of waiting until Monday.
weekendShield.result: Your team arrives Monday to an organized dashboard, not a chaotic list of missed calls.

liveHandoff.title: The 10-second handoff
liveHandoff.body: When patients call during opening hours, your receptionist books the slot and adds one line: next time they can see your open times and book online on DocCy.
liveHandoff.result: Patients type their own name and details; your team reviews and clicks Approve.

websiteButton.title: The website button
websiteButton.body: Already have a website? Send your web person a simple "Book online" button that links to your DocCy page. We don't replace your site, we add a booking path.
websiteButton.result: Need a hand? Contact us through Support and we can add it for you at no extra cost.

AdoptionPlaybook.closing: Once you're verified, open Promote your practice in Settings for ready-made scripts and your booking link.

Showcase.title: See how DocCy puts you back in charge

automatedFollowup.title: Professional automated follow-up
automatedFollowup.body: Once you approve, DocCy does the heavy lifting: confirmation emails, calendar add-ons, and WhatsApp links, with no manual busywork.

overlapGuard.title: Chaos blocked before it starts
overlapGuard.body: When a request overlaps your agenda, DocCy warns you instantly. Adjust duration or use your power to suggest alternative times with one click.

breakGuard.title: Your personal time stays protected
breakGuard.body: DocCy flags conflicts with your breaks or off-hours in real time. Automation finally works for you, not against your boundaries.

smartRequestFilter.title: Smart Requests, not blind bookings
smartRequestFilter.body: Each request arrives structured with patient, time, and reason. You decide with full context from one professional command-center.

pendingClarity.title: No confusion, just clear Pending
pendingClarity.body: Patients see their request as 'Pending' until you give the green light. We manage their expectations to prevent unannounced visits.

pendingVisual.title: Pending is visible at a glance
pendingVisual.body: Pending requests stand out in your agenda, clearly separated from confirmed visits. Nothing enters your day without your explicit approval.

proposalEmail.title: You decide, DocCy follows up
proposalEmail.body: Pick your best three available options. DocCy sends a polished email with a clear 24-hour deadline, so the admin work runs itself.

sync.title: Total Sync
sync.body: Everything is added to your Google or iOS Calendar, matching your preferred language and keeping your life in sync.

weeklyGrid.title: Professional Command Center
weeklyGrid.body: Run your entire week from one visual board. Every booking, request, and gap is clear at a glance. Goodbye, paper diary.

premiumStorefront.title: Your Premium Digital Storefront
premiumStorefront.body: For independents, brand is everything, yet many still lack a real site or settle for cluttered directory pages. DocCy is your showroom: a clean, modern public profile with your photo, specialty, and languages patients scan first, especially across Cyprus's tourism and expat mix.

settingsProfile.title: Profile & Visibility Controls
settingsProfile.body: Manage your professional specialty, languages, and profile readiness from one central place.

settingsSchedule.title: Schedule Customization
settingsSchedule.body: Full control of your practice: set your own boundaries, breaks, slot durations, and booking rules.

SkepticismKiller.title: No more profiles collecting digital dust
SkepticismKiller.p1: We know you’ve probably been burned by healthcare platforms that promise the world, charge upfront, and leave your profile forgotten in a generic database.
SkepticismKiller.p2: DocCy is built differently. We don’t want your money until we prove the system works for your practice.
SkepticismKiller.p3: That’s why we completely eliminate the upfront risk. You get a full business quarter to experience the platform, capture real patients, and see the reduction in phone chaos before you ever pay a single cent.

FAQ.heading: Common questions
FAQ.intro: Right after pricing, most professionals ask these exact questions.

doubleBookings.question: What if a patient calls me by phone? Will I have double bookings?
doubleBookings.answer1: Not at all. DocCy is designed to be your single source of truth. When you or your secretary take a call, you simply add it to your DocCy calendar and (optionally) sync it with your Google/iOS calendar.
doubleBookings.answer2: The slot is instantly blocked on your public profile, so no one can book it online. It is like having a digital shield for your schedule.

frontDeskWorkload.question: Will using DocCy create extra work for my front desk staff?
frontDeskWorkload.answer1: Quite the contrary: it is designed to eliminate phone tag.
frontDeskWorkload.answer2: Right now, your staff spends hours every day managing the "calendar dance": taking calls, checking availability, and playing back-and-forth.
frontDeskWorkload.answer3: With DocCy, you shift your phone traffic to your digital profile. Patients request slots that fit your availability, and your staff simply clicks "Approve" on the dashboard. They spend zero time typing, spelling names, or searching for gaps. It doesn't add to their workload; it acts as a digital shield that protects them from unnecessary phone interruptions, allowing them to focus on the patients standing right in front of them.

patientHabit.question: How do I get my current patients to start using this?
patientHabit.answer1: It is easier than you think. DocCy includes Practice Promotion tools: you can print a QR code for your reception or share your professional link by WhatsApp.
patientHabit.answer2: Your patients will appreciate the freedom to book on a Sunday night without waiting for your clinic to open on Monday morning. You gain peace of mind, they gain convenience.

privateWebsiteVsDoccy.question: Won't a private website give me more visibility than a profile?
privateWebsiteVsDoccy.answer1: It is a common misconception. A private website is like a high-end clinic built in the middle of the desert: it looks great, but no one knows it is there. To appear on the first page of Google, a new website usually needs years of SEO work and thousands of euros in investment.
privateWebsiteVsDoccy.answer2: DocCy is the Main Street of Cyprus healthcare. By joining, you benefit from our platform's established authority and high-performance technology (Vercel). You do not just get a link; you get an optimized professional space that is already where patients are looking.
privateWebsiteVsDoccy.answer3: It is the visibility of a EUR2,000 website for the price of a few coffees.

teamAccess.question: Can my secretary or team manage the agenda for me?
teamAccess.answer1: Absolutely. You can give your team access to your profile so they can confirm, reschedule, or add manual appointments.
teamAccess.answer2: DocCy does not replace your staff; it gives them a high-performance tool to stop wasting time on WhatsApp tag and focus on providing a better experience for the patients in the room.

setupTime.question: How long does it take to set up? I am busy.
setupTime.answer1: Less than 5 minutes. DocCy is built to be plug and play, with no tech team or manuals required.
setupTime.answer2: Want a hands-off experience? As a Founding Member, you can request Personalized Onboarding. We can do it via a quick video call or, if you are based in Paphos, we can visit your practice and set everything up for you.
setupTime.answer3: We'll even help you sync your current calendar and strategy for a smooth transition. You focus on your patients; we handle the setup.

directoriesZeroResults.question: I’ve listed my practice on other directories before and got zero results. Why is DocCy different?
directoriesZeroResults.answer1: Because we don't charge you to sit invisibly in a database. Most traditional directories fail because they focus on locking doctors into upfront contracts without guaranteeing performance.
directoriesZeroResults.answer2: DocCy is built as a high-performance ecosystem optimized for local Google searches. But instead of asking you to trust our word, we shift 100% of the financial risk to us.
directoriesZeroResults.answer3: You get 3 full months to test the platform with zero setup fees and no credit card required. If you don't see actual patient requests or a noticeable relief in your staff's workload, you can walk away without spending a single cent. We only win when your clinic wins.
